title: Director of Operations
text:
**TBK One** began as an environmental consulting firm, helping businesses meet environmental standards through expert guidance, compliance support, and team education. As demand grew across industries such as oil drilling, refining, and concrete manufacturing, the company developed and manufactured its own eco-friendly industrial cleaning solutions to protect both equipment and the environment. Leveraging its expertise in environmental science, manufacturing, packaging, warehousing, and distribution, TBK One expanded its capabilities to support the broader operational needs of other businesses. Today, TBK One is a full-service partner for small and medium-sized businesses, delivering integrated, sustainable solutions backed by more than 20 years of environmental expertise.

**OUR VISION:** To be the premier provider of sustainable and innovative chemical solutions, transforming the way industries blend, package, and distribute their products.

**OUR MISSION:** To provide exceptional chemical blending and distribution services, ensuring quality, sustainability, and customer satisfaction at every step.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Director of Operations is a senior leadership role responsible for day-to-day execution across blending, manufacturing, packaging, quality, warehousing, and distribution. Reporting directly to the CEO/Owner, this position serves as the primary point of operational accountability, translating company priorities into clear plans, scorecards, and measurable results while developing the operations team and organizational structure to support continued growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Leadership & Strategy**

* Own end-to-end accountability for TBK One's daily operations, including blending, manufacturing, packaging, quality control, warehousing, and distribution.
* Translate enterprise and department-level priorities into clear operational plans, scorecards, and accountability for the operations team.
* Build and evolve the operations team structure to support growth and ensure the right people are in the right seats.
* Serve as the senior operational decisionmaker for production scheduling, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
* Report to the CEO/Owner on operational performance, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.

**Manufacturing, Production & Capacity**

* Oversee custom chemical blending, product formulation, reformulation, and full-service manufacturing operations.
* Partner with operational staff to measure plant capacity, throughput, and efficiency and close performance gaps as volume grows.
* Coordinate with Sales to establish realistic production expectations and timelines based on client needs, capacity, and operational requirements.
* Ensure equipment, staffing, and scheduling are aligned to meet customer commitments and seasonal demand.
* Provide operational input on pricing strategies, lead times, and cost estimates for custom blending and packaging products, as needed.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce waste, downtime, and production costs without compromising quality.

**Quality, Compliance & Safety**

* Maintain rigorous quality control standards across raw material inspection, in-process testing, and finished goods.
* Partner with the EHS (Environmental, Health and Safety) Advisor and Accounting/Finance leadership on environmental and regulatory requirements affecting operations, including chemical storage and EPA reporting.
* Champion SOP adherence and documentation across operational areas to support consistent process execution.
* Build and reinforce a strong safety-first culture throughout the warehouse and production floor.

**Warehousing, Distribution & Inventory**

* Oversee warehousing operations, inventory accuracy, and outbound distribution to support on-time, complete fulfillment.
* Optimize logistics and distribution workflows, leveraging TBK One's DFW location and highway access.
* Implement and monitor systems for real-time inventory visibility, cycle counts, and demand forecasting to minimize production interruptions.

**People Leadership & Organizational Systems**

* Lead, manage, and develop operations personnel and managers, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and development priorities as the organization grows.
* Run effective team meetings within the EOS framework, including Level 10 meetings, and maintain department-level scorecards and accountabilities.
* Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, training, and development for operations roles.
* Partner with the CEO/Owner on organizational design and succession planning as the operations function scales.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in operations management, engineering, chemistry, supply chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of progressive operations leadership experience, ideally in chemical manufacturing, industrial blending, or process manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing manufacturing, warehousing, and distribution functions simultaneously.
* Working knowledge of chemical safety, EPA/OSHA compliance, and quality control practices; DOT experience is a plus.
* Proven ability to build, manage, and develop teams, including managers or supervisors.
* Ability to operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment and communication with ownership/CEO.
* Experience with EOS or a similar operating system, including Rocks, scorecards, and Level 10 meetings, is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of production and inventory planning systems is a plus.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and leadership skills.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This position works in both an office setting and production/warehouse environments, with frequent presence required in manufacturing and warehousing areas. Exposure to industrial chemicals, equipment, and noise is expected. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) will be provided and must be worn in accordance with applicable safety protocols. The position requires the ability to walk, stand, and move throughout warehouse and production environments for extended periods.

Join us as we lead the way in environmental innovation! This role offers an exciting chance to influence industry standards while working in a vibrant environment that values leadership, collaboration, and forward-thinking solutions.

Pay: $120,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
